name: Wait-Free Radix Sort
definition: A parallel sorting algorithm designed for WebGPU that avoids inter-workgroup spin-waiting by using a hierarchical Blelloch scan to compute element positions, ensuring consistent behavior across heterogeneous GPU schedulers.
summary: Wait-Free Radix Sort is a parallel GPU sorting algorithm that avoids inter-workgroup spin-waiting by using a hierarchical Blelloch scan to compute element positions without relying on fixed scheduling assumptions.
